judgements.reason: Says trust comes from laziness and vanity; implicitly blames her for confiding.
Don't hurt anyone; unrelated to a broken confidence.
Don't brood on a friend's offence; dismisses a serious betrayal.
A confidant who can't keep a secret betrays you; exactly their hurt.
Hurting back won't heal the injury; useful counsel in the moment.
Friendship requires fidelity; names what was broken.
About secrets in hearts; only a word-level link.
Friendship as solid; general and off the betrayal.
Trust friends fully; she did and was betrayed, so it rings hollow.
Don't distrust a harsh friend; downplays a real breach.
A friend who turns and exposes strife; matches the betrayal.
Friends growing apart in virtue; tangential.
Condemns carrying words between people to stir ill will; names the wrong.
Understand your friend in all conditions; vague.
Grief for a dead friend; off-topic.
Breaking confidence forfeits trust for ever; validates their shock.
Daily life is your temple; offers religion beyond Sunday services.
No devotion without virtue; speaks to rituals without morality.
Religion is being, not talk; relevant to hollow sermons.
Discard in religion what weakens you; supports their questioning.
Even saints lose fervour; normalises the feeling of meaninglessness.
Different natures need different paths to God; opens alternatives.
Faith may be false; loosely relevant.
Religion lives in sincere love, not ceremony; addresses the sham.
Others' wrongs are nothing to you; dense and only partly relevant.
Hearing lectures isn't religion; realisation is. Fits sermon fatigue.
Scolds complaining of dryness; could feel like a rebuke.
Hidden faults among the devout; acknowledges hypocrisy they see.
Fathers shouldn't provoke children; validating but offers no way forward.
Don't add anger to troubles; about trivial annoyances.
Patience with a friend; tangential.
Withholding pardon keeps you stuck in enmity; relevant to moving forward.
Plea not to be abandoned in old age; off-topic.
Despairing of divine justice; unhelpful here.
Go to the one who wronged you; one path for responding.
Debt owed to parents; may feel like pressure toward the father.
Wrongdoers are kin, don't be angry; stern and general.
When father forsakes me, God takes me up; speaks to the old wound.
God rebukes Cain's anger; feels accusing.
Grudges linger after reconciliation; honest about their mixed feelings.
Craving reality through pain; loosely related.
Don't grieve the past; answers how to move forward.
Feeling misunderstood by family as a youth; off-target.
Self-denial in God's will; unrelated.
Distance from parents at a deathbed; off-target.
Adapt to the world; unrelated to body image.
What you see is your shadow, not you; speaks to the mirror.
Be happy rather than seem happy; loose link.
Calls angry people ugly; hurtful to someone who feels ugly.
Judging others' standards about money; off-topic.
A mirror for checking deeds; only a word link.
True beauty is a gentle spirit within; a real reframe.
The plain one was loved; beauty isn't what wins love.
Polished mirror image; tangential.
Mocks an ugly woman; cruel to this person.
Selfishness causes misery; beside the point.
Life is more than food and body; you are valued. Gentle.
Eat in moderation; may feel preachy to someone struggling with eating.
Fear lives in your heart; loosely related.
The weak never reach freedom; harsh in a vulnerable moment.
Seeing your faults in others; off-topic.
Half our troubles come from what others say; fits the hurtful comment.
Treating yourself as an enemy; framed around wrongdoing, could feel blaming.
Eat in moderation; preachy for emotional eating.
Appetite aphorism; off-target.
Self-condemnation and a habit one can't break; mirrors the spiral.
One sore spot absorbs attention; loosely relevant.
Desire fades with fasting; diet advice, not comfort.
Moderation in eating; generic.
Feel for others; loosely related to judgement.
Why bother with others? You've outstripped yourself. Directly on comparison.
Freedom means not fearing people; master of oneself.
Adapt to the world; opposite of living on own terms.
Public opinion is weak next to your own; exactly their question.
Take what is essential from books; loose link.
Treating meanness as knowledge; off-topic.
Follow the promptings of your genius; speaks to their pull toward writing.
Sincerity vs charlatanism; thin link.
Follow your own tendency; forcing another path weakens you.
No one should force an ideal on you; choose what suits you.
Dreams turned to money; touches practicality, off-angle.
Choose an occupation suited to your qualities; directly relevant.
About poetry; doesn't address the decision.
Find your own way, not your father's or mother's.
Truth vs repose and the father's creed; tangential.
Hold to your path despite ridicule; encouraging.
Sing of beauty alone; slight encouragement.
Ruts of conformity; loosely relevant.
How to study; off the decision.
Hard choices; abstract.
There's a fit place for you; vague and urges obedience.
Heartbroken with no comforters; echoes pain, misses guilt.
A mother as peacemaker between others; off-target.
What I have done, I can undo; hope for a guilty parent.
Confession, repentance and restitution; fits guilt, devotional framing.
About being harmed; they did the harm.
Pardon follows a confessed mistake; hope for reconciliation.
Lost in dilemmas; loosely relevant.
Giving up pride in love; vague.
'I have sinned. Return, my son'; a model of a parent's apology.
Confess to one another to be healed; suggests a path.
Worry for a distant son; misses guilt.
Children bring sorrow; unhelpful.
Love is greatest; generic.
Be harsh with yourself; adds to existing guilt.
Fathers, don't provoke children; reads as rebuke.
Lying to a mother; off-topic.
Bearing with difficult people; unrelated.
Remorse as its own justice; acknowledges guilt with compassion.
Banquet of life; doesn't address spouse's response.
Slow solid work; off-topic.
Answer slight with flowers; a gentle response to her coolness.
Success is one kind of life; tangential.
Banquet of life; off the situation.
Not envying sensual pleasure; off-topic.
Envy is natural and painful; helps understand her reaction.
High and low positions; loose link to careers.
Defines jealousy harshly; risks hardening judgement of his wife.
Rejoice in others' favours; addressed to the envious, not him.
Unhappiness of a mismatched calling; indirect insight into her.
Indifference to fortune; off-topic.
Discontent from rising claims; off-target.
Jealousy over precedence; general.
You need a change of soul, not circumstances; exactly their bind.
What burdened poverty burdens riches; the malady travels with you.
Contentment with little; misses the anger and hurt.
Poverty and wealth are passing, not your nature; relevant reframe.
Deceived by poverty, then by wealth; mirrors their experience.
Luxury breeds anger; reads as blame.
Rich and hungry; names wealth not satisfying.
The rich always want more; misses their wound.
Desire brings restlessness; general.
Love of money is evil; judgmental of their striving.
Money's tears and toil; about greed, not childhood hurt.
Clinging to what hurts us; fits holding on to old resentment.
Don't be angry; bare instruction.
Hold wealth lightly; tangential.
No one else can end my discontent; I must. Relevant.
Making money a god; tangential.
Desire causes misery; generic.
Drop the sense of harm; dismissive of childhood hurt.
Poverty enjoying true wealth; thin.
'Why grieve?'; cold to a parent who just lost a son.
Loving death as well as life; risks romanticising death to the bereaved.
Lamp goes out when oxygen runs out; clinical for fresh grief.
Half my soul gone; captures devastating loss, though about a friend.
The world goes on; dismissive of the loss.
Speak of the departed and cherish his memory; gentle and apt.
Life and death as one wave; abstract for fresh grief.
Don't give your heart to sorrow; too soon.
Where is the light; echoes darkness but not grief.
'Do not grieve'; too stern for a parent now.
On one's own death; off-target.
'I have loved'; about one's own death.
Glad to be in the world; jarring right after a child's death.
Death everywhere; spirit immortal. Distant in tone.
Deep understanding between two people is life's greatest satisfaction.
Husband and wife at ease together; fitting blessing.
Being passed over; off-topic.
Happiness in wisdom; unrelated to engagement.
Trust in thy love; a tender line for the moment.
Romance breeds disappointment; deflating on a happy day.
Old age as happiest; off-topic.
Live joyfully with the one you love; celebrates their joy.
Hopes for wealth and long life; unrelated.
No one is in accord with a partner; deflating.
Years of waiting felt like days for love; mirrors their long wait.
Finding what we sought by another path; fits finally finding someone.
